named_offset.xlsx.why: the Check cell reads a defined name with a question mark (Show?), which Excel allows and LibreOffice does not parse; every other result is swept

r42_errs_sar.xlsx: every headline is an error on purpose (a number typed as text, a #REF!, an IRR with no root): there is no figure for LibreOffice to referee; t_errdiag checks the causes and the fixes, and the levered IRR the fix gives against a hand calculation
c43_jv_circ_sar.xlsx: a circular construction loan with iterative calculation: LibreOffice's iteration does not settle on it (levered IRR 35.89% against the exact 25.37%), so it cannot referee it; golden_c43.py solves it exactly and round 43 checks the app against that
c43_dyn_usd.xlsx: Excel 365 functions (SEQUENCE spill, FILTER, UNIQUE) the LibreOffice in CI cannot compute; golden_c43.py computes it independently
lease_freq.xlsx: uses FREQUENCY on purpose: the workbook the second engine (LibreOffice, t_loengine) takes over because the browser engine cannot run it
pic_loop_sar.xlsx: a circular loan (interest funded by the loan itself): LibreOffice's iteration settles short of the exact fixed point, which t_picture checks by hand
pic_spill_usd.xlsx: a timeline spilled by SEQUENCE, which the LibreOffice in CI cannot compute; t_picture checks it against a hand calculation
pic_extlink_usd.xlsx: a headline reading another workbook on purpose (an external link the file does not carry): there is no figure to referee; t_picture checks the error and its cause
c44_phased_sar.xlsx: round 44 fixture: its IRRs read names defined with OFFSET, which the browser engine returns #ERROR! for (round 44 bug 1, open); LibreOffice computes it, so the sweep would fail until the bug is fixed; golden figures in golden/c44.json from an independent Python model
c44_fund_usd.xlsx: round 44 fixture: the fund consolidates its deals with INDIRECT on sheet names read from a list, which the browser engine turns into #N/A (round 44 bug 2, open); skipped until fixed; golden figures in golden/c44.json
c44_fund_direct_usd.xlsx: round 44 fixture (the same fund with direct references): the sweep moves integer quarter inputs by 1%, which the model's IF(q=acquisition) cannot take; its figures are checked against golden/c44.json in the round tests
